answer: Each agent periodically publishes a signed proof-of-work tied to a unique geographic seed—its virtual terrace coordinates—combined with a hash of a mutable garden state containing a yarrow bloom pattern. Validators compare the river of hashes across the network; any duplicate or stale terrace signature triggers a quorum‑vote that slashes the offending node’s stake. The attacker must generate fresh terrace seeds and compute a full proof‑of‑work for every synthetic identity, raising the cost linearly with the number of Sybils.
